parts.note_add: No new 79-85 front console found: Atkins Rotary's console categories start at 1986. Used only (eBay consoles category, PartRequest). The 1985 manual's instrument panel structural view (S-002 sec.14 p.14-2) numbers the brake cover, coin box, rear console and two switch panels as separate pieces around it.
Octoclassic (Spain) lists FA01-64-451 new in black at EUR 75.60 (2026-09-27), described as the series-2 (81-83) console switch panel.
The 1985 manual's instrument panel view (S-002 sec.14 p.14-2, item 10) shows the coin box in the same console position as the switch panels.

Six-terminal rocker: one feed (WG, 10 A fuse shared with the hazard flasher), one ground, LH and RH select leads and two leads common to both mirrors; test it with an ohmmeter against the 1985 manual's continuity table (S-002 p.15-42). Used only: Known Motors USD 30, sold out 2026-09-27; no new FA02-66-600A found (Atkins lists only the 86-91 FB02-66-600B).
No new rear console found; used only. A printable cup-holder tray for its compartment is already in the CAD table (sa-fb-cup-holders-thingiverse-logicallucario).

The 1985 manual's seat structural view (S-002 sec.14 p.14-3) shows both the high-back and the head-rest type: two adjusters, reclining knuckle and knuckle cover, cushion, back, hinge cover, washer, bush and bolt. Inspection: adjuster lever and knuckle move smoothly (grease the moving parts), adjustment lever not worn, mounting bolts tight. No torque given there.

Reproduction covers: Racing Beat kit 4461 for 81-83 lo-back seats with non-leather trim, fabric-backed vinyl in black, burgundy or briar brown, covers for a pair with hog rings and pliers, made to order (GBP 431.52 ex VAT at Racing Beat Europe, 8-10 weeks, 2026-09-27; racingbeat.com Upholstery Kits 1975-85 in the US). Original cloth-velour not reproduced.
No new foam found. Owners report the denser foam blocks in the bolster sides crumble away; the cover is held by hog rings (about half must come off to peel the cover back).
Covered by the same Racing Beat kit 4461 as the cushion cover (pair, vinyl, made to order).
No new foam found; see the cushion frame and pad for the bolster-foam failure owners report.
Service per the 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-3): must move smoothly, grease the moving parts. Not found for sale new; used recline lever assemblies from 1983 GS donors appear on PartRequest.
Service per the 1985 manual (S-002 sec.14 p.14-3): adjuster lever must move smoothly, grease the moving parts, check the lever for wear and the mounting bolts for looseness.
